Inversion: Never have I….explain_en: Inversion means putting the auxiliary verb before the subject, like in a question, after a negative or limiting word at the start: “Never have I seen such a view.” It sounds formal and dramatic.
Inversion: Never have I….explain_ar: القلب معناه إننا نقدّم الفعل المساعد قبل الفاعل زي السؤال، بعد كلمة نفي أو تقييد في أول الجملة: “Never have I seen such a view.” وده أسلوب رسمي وقوي.

examples.en: Never have I felt so proud.
Rarely do we see snow here.

check.question: Which sentence uses inversion?
check.why_ar: Never في الأول وبعدها have قبل I.

Inversion: Never have I….explain_en: Inversion follows words like never, rarely, seldom, hardly … when, no sooner … than, not only … but also, under no circumstances, only then.
Inversion: Never have I….explain_ar: القلب بييجي بعد never وrarely وseldom وhardly … when وno sooner … than وnot only … but also وunder no circumstances وonly then.
Inversion: Never have I….board: Not only did he …, but he also … · Under no circumstances should you …

examples.en: Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
examples.ar: مش بس كسبت، كمان كسرت الرقم القياسي.

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you open this door.
examples.ar: تحت أي ظرف ماتفتحش الباب ده.

check.question: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot his book.
check.why_ar: بعد Not only بنقلب: was he.

Inversion: Never have I….explain_en: If there is no auxiliary in the normal sentence, add do, does or did: “I rarely go out” → “Rarely do I go out.” “She seldom complained” → “Seldom did she complain.”
Inversion: Never have I….explain_ar: لو مفيش فعل مساعد في الجملة العادية بنضيف do أو does أو did: “Rarely do I go out.”
Inversion: Never have I….board: Rarely do I … · Seldom did she …

examples.en: Hardly ever do they eat meat.
Little did he know what was coming.
examples.ar: ماكانش يعرف خالص إيه اللي جاي.

check.question: “She rarely smiles.” → “Rarely ___.”
check.why_ar: نضيف does والفعل في أصله: does she smile.

Inversion: Never have I….explain_en: For one thing happening right after another: “Hardly had I arrived when the phone rang.” / “No sooner had we sat down than the show started.” Note: hardly … when, no sooner … than.
Inversion: Never have I….explain_ar: لحاجة حصلت على طول بعد حاجة: “Hardly had I arrived when …” و“No sooner had we sat down than …”. لاحظ: hardly مع when، وno sooner مع than.
Inversion: Never have I….board: Hardly had … when · No sooner had … than

examples.en: No sooner had I left than it started to rain.
Hardly had the film begun when the lights went out.

check.question: No sooner had we arrived ___ the meeting began.
check.why_ar: No sooner بتيجي معاها than.

Inversion: Never have I….recap_en: After negative or limiting words at the start of a sentence, put the auxiliary before the subject, adding do or did when needed. It makes writing formal and emphatic.

Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_en: Cleft sentences split one idea into two parts to focus on the important information: “I need a holiday” → “What I need is a holiday.”
Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_ar: الجمل المشقوقة بتقسم الفكرة لجزئين عشان تركز على المعلومة المهمة: “What I need is a holiday.”

examples.en: What I love about Cairo is the energy.
examples.ar: اللي بحبه في القاهرة هو الحيوية.

examples.en: What we need is more time.

check.question: Which sentence focuses on “patience”?
check.why_ar: What … is بتسلط الضوء على patience.

Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_en: Use “It is / It was … that / who” to emphasise one part: “Sara broke the window” → “It was Sara who broke the window (not Ali).”
Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_ar: “It was … who/that” بتأكد جزء معين: “It was Sara who broke the window (not Ali).”
Cleft sentences: What I need is….board: It was + focus + who / that + rest

examples.en: It was in Alexandria that I met her.
It’s the price that worries me.

check.question: “My brother called you.” → “It was my brother ___ called you.”
check.why_ar: للأشخاص بنستخدم who.

Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_en: Similar patterns: “All I want is…” (only this), “The thing (that) I like most is…”, “The reason (why) … is that…”.
Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_ar: تراكيب شبيهة: “All I want is…” (بس كده)، و“The thing I like most is…”، و“The reason … is that…”.
Cleft sentences: What I need is….board: All I want is … · The reason … is that …

examples.en: All I want is some peace and quiet.
The reason I’m late is that the bus broke down.
examples.ar: السبب إني اتأخرت إن الأتوبيس عطل.

check.question: “I only want to sleep.” → “___ I want is to sleep.”
check.why_ar: All I want is = كل اللي عايزه.

Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_en: To focus on an action, use “What … do is (to) + verb”: “What you should do is call her.” “What happened was (that) the car broke down.”
Cleft sentences: What I need is….explain_ar: عشان نركز على فعل: “What you should do is call her.” و“What happened was that the car broke down.”
Cleft sentences: What I need is….board: What you should do is + verb · What happened was …

examples.en: What I did was apologise immediately.
What happened was that we got lost.

check.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: What you should doing is rest.
What you should do is rest.
What should you do is rest.
check.why_ar: What you should do is + الفعل في أصله.

Cleft sentences: What I need is….recap_en: Cleft sentences split an idea to highlight what matters: What I need is…, It was … who…, All I want is… — powerful in speaking and writing.

Mixed conditionals.explain_en: Mixed conditionals connect different times. The most common: an imaginary past action with a present result: “If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.”
Mixed conditionals.explain_ar: الشرط المختلط بيربط أزمنة مختلفة. أشهرهم: فعل ماضي خيالي ونتيجته في الحاضر: “If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.”

examples.en: If I had taken that job, I would live in Dubai now.
examples.ar: لو كنت قبلت الشغلانة دي كنت هبقى عايش في دبي دلوقتي.

examples.en: If she hadn’t missed the flight, she would be here.
examples.ar: لو ماكانتش الطيارة فاتتها كانت هتبقى هنا.

check.question: “If I had saved money, I ___ rich now.”
check.why_ar: النتيجة في الحاضر (now) → would be.

Mixed conditionals.explain_en: The other type: a present (permanent) situation explains a past result: “If I were braver, I would have spoken to her.” (I’m not brave, so I didn’t.)
Mixed conditionals.explain_ar: النوع التاني: حالة في الحاضر (دايمة) بتفسر نتيجة في الماضي: “If I were braver, I would have spoken to her.”
Mixed conditionals.board: If + past simple (always true), … would have done (past)

examples.en: If he were more careful, he wouldn’t have crashed the car.
examples.ar: لو كان أحرص ماكانش خبط العربية.

examples.en: If I spoke French, I would have understood the film.
examples.ar: لو كنت بعرف فرنساوي كنت فهمت الفيلم.

check.question: “I don’t speak Arabic well, so I didn’t understand.” → “If I ___ Arabic well, I would have understood.”
check.why_ar: الحالة دايمة في الحاضر → spoke.

Mixed conditionals.explain_en: Ask two questions: When is the condition — past or always/now? When is the result — past or now? Then choose: past → had done; now → past simple; result now → would + verb; result past → would have done.
Mixed conditionals.explain_ar: اسأل سؤالين: الشرط إمتى (ماضي ولا دايماً)؟ والنتيجة إمتى (ماضي ولا دلوقتي)؟ وبعدين اختار التركيب.
Mixed conditionals.board: condition time + result time → choose the forms

examples.en: If you had listened, you wouldn’t be confused now.
examples.ar: لو كنت سمعت ماكنتش هتبقى متلخبط دلوقتي.

examples.en: If I didn’t trust you, I wouldn’t have told you.
examples.ar: لو ماكنتش بثق فيك ماكنتش قلتلك.

check.question: “If we had left on time, we ___ there by now.”
check.why_ar: by now → النتيجة في الحاضر: would be.

Mixed conditionals.explain_en: Mixed conditionals are common when talking about life choices and regrets: “If I hadn’t moved to Jeddah, I wouldn’t know my best friend.”
Mixed conditionals.explain_ar: الشرط المختلط بيتقال كتير لما نتكلم عن اختيارات الحياة والندم: “If I hadn’t moved to Jeddah, I wouldn’t know my best friend.”
Mixed conditionals.board: life choices · regrets · imagining another life

examples.en: If I had learned English as a child, I’d be fluent now.
examples.ar: لو كنت اتعلمت إنجليزي وأنا صغير كنت هبقى بطلاقة دلوقتي.

examples.en: If she weren’t so kind, she wouldn’t have helped us.
examples.ar: لو ماكانتش طيبة كده ماكانتش ساعدتنا.

check.question: “If I hadn’t met my teacher, I ___ English today.”
check.why_ar: today → النتيجة في الحاضر: wouldn’t love.

Mixed conditionals.recap_en: Mixed conditionals join different times: an imaginary past with a present result, or a present situation with a past result. Decide the time of each half first.

Discourse markers for essays.explain_en: Discourse markers guide the reader through your ideas: they show order, addition, contrast, cause and conclusion. Good essays use a variety of them.
Discourse markers for essays.explain_ar: أدوات الربط بتوجّه القارئ في أفكارك: بتوضح الترتيب والإضافة والتناقض والسبب والخلاصة. والمقالات الكويسة بتنوّع فيها.

examples.en: Firstly, technology saves time.
In conclusion, both sides have a point.
examples.ar: في الختام، كل طرف عنده وجهة نظر.

check.question: Which marker shows a conclusion?
check.why_ar: To sum up = باختصار/في الختام.

Discourse markers for essays.explain_en: To add ideas: moreover, furthermore, in addition, what is more. To give examples: for instance, for example, such as. These replace simple “and” and “also”.
Discourse markers for essays.explain_ar: للإضافة: moreover وfurthermore وin addition. وللأمثلة: for instance وsuch as. ودول بيحلوا محل and وalso البسيطة.
Discourse markers for essays.board: Moreover, … · For instance, … · such as + noun

examples.en: Moreover, online learning is cheaper.
examples.ar: علاوة على ذلك، التعلم أونلاين أرخص.

examples.en: Many sports, such as tennis, improve focus.
examples.ar: رياضات كتير زي التنس بتحسن التركيز.

check.question: Reading is relaxing. ___, it improves vocabulary.
check.why_ar: بنضيف فكرة تانية في نفس الاتجاه → Furthermore.

Discourse markers for essays.explain_en: Result: therefore, as a result, consequently. Cause: due to, owing to (+ noun). Contrast: however, on the other hand, nevertheless, whereas.
Discourse markers for essays.explain_ar: النتيجة: therefore وas a result. السبب: due to + اسم. التناقض: however وon the other hand وnevertheless وwhereas.
Discourse markers for essays.board: Therefore, … · due to + noun · On the other hand, …

examples.en: Prices rose. As a result, sales fell.
examples.ar: الأسعار زادت، ونتيجة لكده المبيعات قلت.

examples.en: City life is exciting, whereas village life is calm.
examples.ar: حياة المدينة مثيرة، بينما حياة القرية هادية.

check.question: The flight was cancelled ___ bad weather.
check.why_ar: due to + اسم (bad weather) للسبب.

Discourse markers for essays.explain_en: A strong paragraph moves clearly: a topic sentence, then ideas linked with markers, then a closing sentence. Don’t overuse them — one or two per sentence is enough.
Discourse markers for essays.explain_ar: الفقرة القوية: جملة موضوع، وبعدين أفكار مربوطة بأدوات ربط، وبعدين جملة ختام. وماتكترش منهم — واحدة أو اتنين في الجملة كفاية.
Discourse markers for essays.board: topic sentence → support (Firstly / Moreover) → contrast (However) → conclusion (Therefore)

examples.en: Firstly, … Moreover, … However, … Therefore, …
examples.ar: أولاً… علاوة على ذلك… ومع ذلك… لذلك…

examples.en: On the one hand…, on the other hand…

check.question: Best final sentence marker:
check.why_ar: جملة الختام بتبدأ بـ In conclusion.

Discourse markers for essays.recap_en: Discourse markers like firstly, moreover, however, therefore and in conclusion guide the reader. Use a variety, but don’t overuse them.

Idioms in context.explain_en: An idiom is a group of words whose meaning is different from the individual words: “It’s a piece of cake” means it is very easy — not real cake!
Idioms in context.explain_ar: المصطلح مجموعة كلمات معناها مختلف عن معنى كل كلمة لوحدها: “It’s a piece of cake” يعني سهلة جداً، مش كيك بجد!
Idioms in context.board: idiom = fixed phrase with a new meaning

examples.en: The exam was a piece of cake.
I’m feeling under the weather today.

check.question: “A piece of cake” means …
check.why_ar: a piece of cake = سهلة جداً.

Idioms in context.explain_en: Useful ones: “once in a blue moon” (very rarely), “call it a day” (stop working), “burn the midnight oil” (work late), “hit the books” (study hard).
Idioms in context.explain_ar: مصطلحات مفيدة: once in a blue moon (نادراً جداً)، call it a day (نكتفي كده)، burn the midnight oil (نسهر نشتغل)، hit the books (نذاكر جامد).
Idioms in context.board: once in a blue moon · call it a day · hit the books

examples.en: We only eat out once in a blue moon.
It’s late — let’s call it a day.

check.question: Before exams, students often ___.
options: cost an arm and a leg
check.why_ar: hit the books = يذاكر جامد.

Idioms in context.explain_en: “Break the ice” (start a friendly conversation), “over the moon” (very happy), “in hot water” (in trouble), “cost an arm and a leg” (very expensive).
Idioms in context.explain_ar: break the ice (يكسر الحواجز)، over the moon (مبسوط جداً)، in hot water (في مشكلة)، cost an arm and a leg (غالي جداً).
Idioms in context.board: over the moon = very happy · in hot water = in trouble

examples.en: She was over the moon with her results.
That phone cost an arm and a leg.

check.question: He told a joke to ___ at the meeting.
check.why_ar: يكسر الحواجز في أول لقاء → break the ice.

Idioms in context.explain_en: Use idioms in informal speaking, not in formal essays. Don’t change their words: say “a piece of cake”, not “a slice of cake”. Learn them with a real example.
Idioms in context.explain_ar: استخدم المصطلحات في الكلام غير الرسمي مش في المقالات الرسمية. وماتغيرش كلماتها: a piece of cake مش a slice of cake.
Idioms in context.board: informal speaking ✓ · formal essay ✗ · don’t change the words

examples.en: Don’t worry, the test will be a piece of cake!
I got the job — I’m over the moon!
examples.ar: اتقبلت في الشغل — أنا مبسوط جداً!

check.question: Where is “a piece of cake” most natural?
check.why_ar: المصطلحات مناسبة للكلام غير الرسمي.

Idioms in context.recap_en: Idioms are fixed phrases with special meanings. Learn them with examples, keep the words exactly the same, and use them in informal speaking.

Formal and informal English.explain_en: English changes with the situation. We use informal English with friends and family, and formal English in emails to companies, essays, interviews and official letters.
Formal and informal English.explain_ar: الإنجليزي بيتغير حسب الموقف: غير رسمي مع الأصحاب والعيلة، ورسمي في الإيميلات للشركات والمقالات والمقابلات والجوابات الرسمية.

examples.en: Hi Sara! What’s up?
Dear Mr Hassan, I am writing to enquire about…
examples.ar: السيد حسن المحترم، أكتب للاستفسار عن…

check.question: Which is formal?
options: I would be grateful if you could contact me.
check.why_ar: I would be grateful if … أسلوب رسمي.

Formal and informal English.explain_en: Formal English avoids contractions (I’m → I am) and uses more formal words: get → receive, ask → enquire, help → assist, need → require, buy → purchase.
Formal and informal English.explain_ar: الرسمي بيتجنب الاختصارات (I’m → I am) وبيستخدم كلمات رسمية: receive بدل get، وenquire بدل ask، وassist بدل help.
Formal and informal English.board: get → receive · help → assist · buy → purchase

examples.en: We have received your application.
Please let me know if I can assist you further.
examples.ar: من فضلك بلغني لو أقدر أساعدك أكتر.

check.question: Formal version of “I want to buy a ticket”:
options: I would like to purchase a ticket.
check.why_ar: would like وpurchase أسلوب رسمي.

Formal and informal English.explain_en: Formal requests are indirect: “Could you…?”, “Would you mind…?”, “I would appreciate it if…”. Informal: “Can you…?”, “Send me…”.
Formal and informal English.explain_ar: الطلبات الرسمية غير مباشرة: Could you…? وWould you mind…? وI would appreciate it if…. وغير الرسمي: Can you…?
Formal and informal English.board: Could you …? · Would you mind + -ing? · I would appreciate it if …

examples.en: Would you mind sending me the file?
I would appreciate it if you could reply soon.

check.question: Most formal request:
options: Could you please send me the report?
check.why_ar: Could you please … الأكثر رسمية وأدب.

Formal and informal English.explain_en: Formal email: “Dear Ms Ali,” … “Kind regards,” / “Yours sincerely,”. Informal: “Hi Omar,” … “See you soon!” / “Cheers,”. Match the style from start to finish.
Formal and informal English.explain_ar: الإيميل الرسمي: “Dear Ms Ali,” وفي الآخر “Kind regards,”. وغير الرسمي: “Hi Omar,” و“See you soon!”. وخلي الأسلوب واحد من الأول للآخر.
Formal and informal English.board: Dear … / Kind regards · Hi … / See you!

examples.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about…
Hi Mona, thanks for the photos! See you soon.
examples.ar: أهلاً منى، شكراً على الصور! أشوفك قريب.

check.question: Best closing for an email to a company:
check.why_ar: Kind regards خاتمة رسمية مناسبة.

Formal and informal English.recap_en: Choose formal or informal English by situation. Formal English avoids contractions, uses formal words and indirect requests, and keeps the same style from greeting to closing.
